issues_fixed.7_manifest_validation: near duplicates require reviewed --resolved; empty/missing-field/duplicate-id/source-hash/pair-split/lineage failures; no report overwrite
issues_fixed.8_split_limitations: 5 writers preferred (2 dev/3 test), min 4; same-amount limitation documented; image-only inputs to recognition
issues_fixed.9_stress_safeguards: parent hash, read/write checks, metadata + lineage preserved, overwrite refusal; legibility caveat; runtime estimate
